fields.label: Ticket Routing
fields.description: Ticket Type decides the Helpdesk Team; the Team's round-robin rule picks the agent.

fields.label: Repair-In Warehouse
fields.description: Customer units under repair (zero value).

fields.label: Repair WIP Warehouse
fields.description: Spares reserved for repairs.

fields.label: Loaner / Replacement Source Warehouse
fields.description: Finished-goods store that loaner and replacement units leave from.

fields.label: Customer Loaner Warehouse
fields.description: Loaner units currently with customers.

fields.label: Warranty Expense Account
fields.description: Expense head for free (in-warranty) parts.

fields.label: Chargeable Parts Expense Account
fields.description: Optional. Blank = ERPNext default expense account.

fields.label: Freight Item
fields.description: Optional. When set, added to every repair quotation.

fields.label: Advance Required %
fields.description: Share of the repair order to be paid before work starts. Dispatch always needs 100%.

fields.label: Charge AMC Repairs
fields.description: Off (Fortuna): AMC repairs are free, except Items ticked "Not Covered by AMC" (consumables such as biometric sensors and batteries), which are charged.

fields.label: Replacement Keeps Old Warranty
fields.description: Default for replacement units (Fortuna: normally keeps the original warranty). Each Repair Order can override it in Replacement Warranty.

fields.label: Standard Warranty (days)
fields.description: Normal warranty is 1 year. Used when the Item has no Warranty Period of its own.

fields.label: AMC Enquiry Lead Days
fields.description: Days before warranty end to alert the AMC team.

fields.label: AMC Team Email(s)
fields.description: Comma separated.

fields.label: Create Opportunities
fields.description: One CRM Opportunity (Request Type: AMC Renewal) per unit in the daily AMC enquiry.

fields.label: AMC Opportunity Owner
fields.description: Blank = first user with the AMC Team role.

fields.label: SIM Billing Mode
fields.description: Open point: Subscription = billed by ERPNext Subscriptions; Service Order = daily draft Sales Orders.

fields.label: Payment Due Before
fields.description: Fortuna: full payment before the repaired unit is shipped (Dispatch). Repair Start = the advance below must be paid before work begins.

fields.label: AMC Terms
fields.description: Filled on AMC quotations and orders that have no terms yet.

fields.label: Repair Terms
fields.description: Filled on repair quotations.

fields.label: Payment Terms Template
fields.description: Fortuna: 100% against Pro-Forma Invoice.

fields.label: AMC Alert CC
fields.description: Comma separated. Copied on warranty-ending and AMC renewal alerts.

fields.label: Customer Reminder Days
fields.description: Days before SIM validity ends to e-mail the customer, e.g. 30, 15 (two reminders). Blank = no reminders.

fields.label: Customer Reminder CC
fields.description: Comma separated. Copied on every SIM renewal reminder.
